diagnosis.rationale: The undiluted culture rises rapidly to ~0.49 by 5 h and then remains near ~0.49–0.515, which could indicate either stationary phase or reader saturation. Dilution checks argue against hidden biomass: the 18 h aliquot at 10× gave 0.0511 ± 0.0004 (×10 = 0.511), matching the undiluted 18 h reading of 0.492 within a few percent; the 17 h 10× check gave ×10 = 0.540 versus 0.510 undiluted, also close. If the true final OD were substantially higher (e.g. 1–5), the 10× diluted samples should have read ~0.1–0.5 rather than ~0.05. The 50× 18 h reading was low-signal/noisy (×50 = 0.34) and does not indicate a larger value. Thus the late plateau is best explained as real biomass around OD600 ~0.5 rather than an instrument ceiling.
